name: Surface Modeling via Boundary Tracking and Marching Cubes
aliases: Boundary Surface Extraction via Region Growing
definition: A method to construct compact, hole-free boundary surfaces for extracted features, followed by optional smoothing via isosurface extraction.
summary: This method extracts compact, hole-free surfaces from noisy volumetric data by tracking segmented boundaries before applying Marching Cubes, avoiding the artifacts of direct extraction.
